title: Baza
extract:
The Baza is a   Tenno silenced submachine gun with a high critical chance, critical multiplier, fire rate and  accuracy at the cost medium range damage falloff and a small magazine.

Characteristics
This weapon deals primarily  Puncture damage.
This weapon is Silent.
Low zoom when aiming.
Shorter damage falloff distance for a hit-scan weapon.
Advantages over other Primary   weapons (excluding modular weapons):

Very high accuracy per shot, even at full auto.
Negligible recoil.
Silent nature allows for stealth usage.
Lower zoom allows for a more stable view.
Normal Attack (wiki attack index 1)
Above average crit chance (26.00%)
Very high fire rate (16.67 attacks/sec)
Very high ammo pickup (80)
Above average accuracy (1.00° to 1.50°)
High reload speed (1.40 s)
Very high ammo max (800)
Very high crit multiplier (3.00x)
Disadvantages over other Primary   weapons (excluding modular weapons):

Has linear damage falloff from 100% to 50% starting at 22m until 34m target distance (distances are affected by Projectile Speed).
Cannot equip  Terminal Velocity.
Poor ammo economy.
Normal Attack (wiki attack index 1)
Below average active falloff slope (24.0m/%)
Below average maximum falloff distance (34.0 m)
Below average burst DPS (405.41)
Below average sustained DPS (256.03)
Very low total damage (16)
Very low damage per shot (24.32)
Very low status chance (10.00%)
Below average disposition (●●●○○ (1.05x))
See WARFRAME Wiki:Stat Comparison/Percentiles for more details.
Comparisons:

 Baza (Normal Attack), compared to  Baza Prime (Normal Attack):
Equal base damage
Lower base critical chance (26.00% vs. 28.00%)
Lower base status chance (10.00% vs. 14.00%)
Lower average damage per tap (24.32 vs. 24.96)
Lower burst DPS (405.41 vs. 416.08)
Lower sustained DPS (256.03 vs. 318.68)
Closer starting damage falloff distance (22.0 m vs. 30.0 m)
Closer max damage falloff distance (34.0 m vs. 60.0 m)
Smaller magazine (40 vs. 60)
Smaller max ammo capacity (800 vs. 840)
Slower reload time (1.40 s vs. 1.10 s)
Less polarities ( vs. )
Lower Mastery Rank required (7 vs. 10)
Higher disposition (●●●○○ (1.05x) vs. ●●●○○ (1.00x))

Acquisition
The Baza's blueprint can be researched from the Tenno Lab in the dojo.

Notes
The weapon's firing sounds increases in pitch when 15 or fewer rounds are remaining in the magazine, indicating that the weapon's magazine is almost empty.
The weapon has minimal zoom when aiming, helpful for mods that add bonuses while aiming like  Argon Scope.

Tips
The Baza's high accuracy allows it to land headshots consistently compared to other automatic weapons, which along with its good critical hit chance makes it ideal for builds using  Argon Scope.
Its lower status chance compared to some other automatic rifles can be alleviated with the  Hunter Munitions mod, allowing the weapon to spread  Slash procs rapidly to enemies, which helps the weapon a lot versus heavy armor.
Its silenced nature makes it synergize well with  Ivara, as firing the weapon will not interrupt her  Prowl ability.
Since the Baza has very high accuracy, it can use Heavy Caliber with almost no drawback and increasing the weapon's overall damage output.

Trivia
The Baza are a genus of bird of prey in the Accipitridae family.
Physically, the weapon bears a strong resemblance to the real-life PP-19 Bizon SMG, due to Baza's underbarrel, horizontal magazine, and its overall appearance.
The name Baza may be derived from the PP-19's nickname, Bizon.
The name Baza (shortening of "Barry") is strongly believe to be derived from a conversation had at PAX Aus between DE staff and fans, where "Australian Names" were discussed. It was claimed that "Baza" may be the "most Australian name".  There was also discussion about many great names from native flora and fauna (released with the  Cassowar).
Tied with  Soma/ Soma Prime,  Attica, and  Baza Prime for the highest critical multiplier of all fully automatic rifles.
Second fastest reload speed of all fully automatic rifles, behind  Baza Prime.
Tied with  Baza Prime for the third fastest fire rate of all fully automatic rifles, behind  Grakata and  Prisma Grakata.
Tied with  Baza Prime for the fourth lowest base damage of all fully automatic rifles, after  Prisma Grakata,  Soma/ Soma Prime, and  Grakata; very reliant on its high critical damage potential.
